prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, and preferred working style. To give a useful recommendation I need a little more info. Quick questions:

- What are your main goals? (brand/creative, website, SEO, digital ads/PPC, social, PR, B2B lead gen, e‑commerce, etc.)
- What’s your monthly or project budget range?
- Are you a small business, startup, or enterprise?
- Do you want a full‑service agency or a specialist boutique?

If you want a starting point: Kansas City is home to several well‑regarded agencies, including large full‑service shops (for example Barkley and VML/VMLY&R) and many strong local boutiques that specialize in digital, creative, or B2B work. Which is right depends on the answers above.

How I can help next:
- If you tell me the answers to the questions above, I’ll shortlist 3–5 Kansas City agencies matched to your needs (with why each is a fit).
- I can also provide an RFP template or a list of interview questions to vet agencies.

Which option would you like?
